crop and premultiplied-alpha resize the generated telephone, then composite it at the Desk's corrected phone location while excluding all malformed source-phone remnants
trace the calculator's complete silhouette and hit region, including its raised display housing, while stopping source-phone cleanup above it
copy source pixels only where coverage is nonzero into a black-backed RGB overlay

encode zero for background and IconId values 1 through 13 for semantic object-only hit testing, crediting each pixel to the front-most prop whose own silhouette covers it within that prop's declared bounds
write the overlay, coverage mask, and semantic ID map as binary P6
chroma_operations: remove the uniform chroma backdrop from telephone-sprite-source.png and game-media-source.png
preserve antialiased subject coverage as RGBA alpha
game_media_operations: divide the preserved transparent source into an exact 3x3 grid
crop each cell to its alpha bounds and resize premultiplied color with Lanczos into a padded 48x56 canonical cell
assemble a black-backed 144x168 RGB atlas and matching RGB-encoded grayscale alpha mask
preparation.reproducibility: All thirteen runtime P6 files were regenerated with the recorded tools and compared byte-for-byte with the committed files.
